title: CompareTable
description: contracts/claims/compare.v1.json (D113): the landing page's comparison table, columns by rows of other kinds of tools. TrustAgent's own row is not here: it reads the value claims. A cell says what the vendor documents, never a ranking. A cell other than unverified needs the source_url its author actually fetched (public docs, read-only) and as_of, the fetch date (validate.mjs). The landing shows unverified as "Not yet verified"; check-claims --launch refuses any unverified or reviewed:false cell, and the owner reviews every vendor cell before launch.

examples.description: The products this kind of tool is known by, as the vendors name them.

cells.description: One cell per column id (validate.mjs checks that every column has one and no other key appears).

value.description: no only where the vendor's documentation says so; otherwise varies with "Not documented (as of …)".

text.description: What the vendor documents, in one plain sentence (empty while unverified).

reviewed.description: The owner reviewed this cell (false until then).
